limitations: Fresh actual-main qualification covers the merged capability-register source slice and preserved runtime/package gates, not production deployment or live remote enrollment.
The capability register is an explicitly dated snapshot; partial component counts do not award whole-requirement completion or update live production status.
Codex registration and SDK calls to the configured command are verified; no actual Codex agent tool invocation or model call occurred.
Five runtime package license files and bounded provenance checks passed; full transitive license clearance, runtime-image redistribution eligibility and full Desktop Commander parity remain false.
Native Linux evidence covers 12 bounded real source and 12 installed scenarios with cleanup, plus 31 separate synthetic protocol tests; it is not complete isolation acceptance.
